visual_action: A fast-paced montage of United States military hardware and personnel. The video includes shots of fighter jets on an aircraft carrier, flying in the air, and being refueled mid-flight. There are also shots of a large bomber, a missile launch, soldiers in combat gear in various environments (on a ship, in a snowy forest), and silhouettes of personnel on a runway at sunset. One short clip shows Donald Trump walking outdoors, wearing a suit and a white 'USA' cap.
